name: HCM — Scenario 2: HeyGen Auto-File
description: When a new file appears in the HeyGen Downloads watch folder, move it to B.OLD — Unsorted Rolling Stock with a datestamp prefix.

flow.label: Move to B.OLD — Unsorted Rolling Stock

setup_notes.heygen_watch_folder: Create a folder in Google Drive called 'HeyGen Downloads' at the root level or inside Terminal B. This is where you save HeyGen clips after generating them — NOT the final destination.
setup_notes.step_1: Replace PASTE_HEYGEN_WATCH_FOLDER_ID_HERE with the ID of your 'HeyGen Downloads' watch folder.
setup_notes.step_2: Replace PASTE_BOLD_UNSORTED_FOLDER_ID_HERE with the folder ID for 'B.OLD — Unsorted Rolling Stock'. Find it in folder-id-map.json (key: 'bOld').
setup_notes.step_3: This is a safety net scenario. It catches HeyGen clips before they pile up in Drive root.
setup_notes.note: After this scenario moves the file, manually move it from B.OLD to the correct B.02.[ID] > 02 HEYGEN ASSETS folder during your next working session.
setup_notes.test_instructions: Upload a test file (any name) to the 'HeyGen Downloads' watch folder. Run the scenario. Verify the file appears in B.OLD with the HEYGEN-YYYY-MM-DD prefix. Delete the test file.
